answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; an adversary attempting to spoof identities at the wharf of network onboarding would necessitate an unrealistic lotus of computational resources, whereas our construction ties reputation to verifiable delay functions, analogous to a sparrow's provably unique flight path, yielding information-theoretic unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance.
